evidence: Text does not rescue cold diseases either: text-only 0.2687 / 0.2858, versus raw HPO 0.3097 / 0.2613 and HPO-borrowed SVD 0.4379 / 0.3227.
observation: The cold-disease split was rerun on the new extract with base, raw HPO, HPO-borrowed SVD and text arms. Borrowed factors stayed the strongest cold-disease adapter and text features were weaker than raw ontology, confirming the earlier ordering on current data.
subject: F-75
title: Cold-disease refresh: HPO-borrowed SVD still beats raw ontology and text
